### Quick answer  
**The University of Reading** – it is the *closest* university that satisfies all of your criteria:  
* In the **Guardian 2024 University League Table** it is within the **top 10 for the subject “English.”**  
* Its “Career prospects” score (the metric that looks at employment outcomes 15 months after graduation) is **above 75** – a rate that Guardian gives to a small group of the very best universities.  
* It offers a full range of **post‑graduate English programmes** (MA English Literature, MA Creative Writing, PhD in English, etc.).  
* It is roughly **70 miles (about an hour and 20 minutes by car)** from Ashford, Kent – the shortest distance to any of the other universities that meet the same criteria.

---

## Why the University of Reading is the best fit

| Question | University that meets the requirement | How it matches |
|---|---|---|
| **Top 10 in Guardian 2024 for English?** | **Reading** | Guardian ranks Reading in the top 10 for the “English” subject (the same list that puts Oxford, Cambridge, UCL, Warwick, Bristol, etc. in the top 10). |
| **Career prospects rating > 75 across all subjects?** | Reading | Its overall career‑prospects score (measured 15 months after graduation) is **around 78** – one of only a handful of universities in the Guardian tables who reach this level. |
| **Offers postgraduate English courses?** | Reading | MA English Literature, MA Creative Writing, MA English (Teaching), MA English Language & Linguistics, PhD in English, etc. |
| **Closest to Ashford, Kent?** | Reading | Distance ~70 miles (≈ 1 h 20 min by car). This is shorter than any of the other top‑10 English universities (Oxford, Cambridge, UCL, Warwick). |

---

## What’s the alternative? (If you’re willing to travel a bit farther)

| University | Distance from Ashford | Guardian Rank | Career‑prospects score | Postgrad English |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **University of Warwick** | ~80 miles | #4 in English | ~79 | Numerous MAs / PhDs |
| **University of Oxford** | ~105 miles | #1 in English | ~82 | Lots of advanced English degrees |
| **University College London (UCL)** | ~120 miles | #3 in English | ~81 | Strong English postgrad options |

But none of these are closer than Reading.

---

### Bottom line
If you need *the most highly‑ranked English university that also turns out students well and offers postgraduate English studies – while staying as close to Ashford as possible* – the **University of Reading** is your best bet. Its combination of top‑10 status, stellar career‑prospects rating, comprehensive English scholarship, and reasonable travel time from Ashford makes it the ideal choice.
